title: Partially-Commutative Polynomial Optimization
summary: Semidefinite programming hierarchies for commutative and non-commutative polynomial optimization represent a powerful computational tool with many applications in quantum information. In such applications, a given variable is typically not either commuting or non-commuting with all other variables, but instead commutes with some variables and does not commute with others, i.e., the variables satisfy some partial commutation relations.
